shared_elements: low relief carving in weathered stone
profile figures arranged in a row
band of short parallel strokes / linear pattern
outdoor archaeological setting with rubble and open sky/ground
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief on weathered stone and share the device of a horizontal band of repeated profile figures topped or bordered by a strip of simple linear ornament, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a long, multi-register architectural frieze of finely modelled, densely detailed human processional figures, while B is a single free-standing slab bearing a few sparse, schematic, flatly outlined animal forms with large empty ground.
